The '''Basilisk system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Coruscant sector/Legends|Coruscant sector]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Basilisk]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Basiliskan]]s.
